items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS
items.blurb: AWS now offers Claude Haiku 5.5, the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

items.title: AWS Capabilities by Region now offers availability notifications for individual features and advanced filters
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces feature-level availability notifications and advanced filters for AWS Capabilities by Region in AWS Builder Center.

items.title: AWS Batch now publishes job metrics to Amazon CloudWatch
items.blurb: AWS Batch now publishes job metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, providing native observability for batch workloads.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Desktop now available for PC and Mac
items.blurb: Raspberry Pi Desktop is all updated for Debian Trixie and available now for your PCs and Macs. It even includes a Raspberry Pi Connect client.

items.title: Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Singapore)
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances are available in Asia Pacific (Singapore) region. These instances are powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors (formerly code named Turin).

items.title: Amazon EC2 introduces shared tags for Amazon Machine Images
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 now supports AMI tag sharing, a new feature that lets AMI owners make selected tags visible to all AWS accounts an AMI is shared with.

items.title: AWS Client VPN now supports device posture assessment
items.blurb: AWS Client VPN now supports device posture assessment, allowing you to verify that connecting user devices meet your security and compliance requirements before granting network access.

items.title: Another Step Towards Elm 1.0
items.blurb: We are on a faster release cycle these days, so the post also has a rough roadmap about what to expect from the next few releases. submitted by /u/wheatBread [link] [comments]
